benchmark.description: Five independent localization-heavy tasks over one multi-package service repository, frozen before the first live-model evaluation. Each task crosses module boundaries and includes legacy or experimental distractors.
benchmark.name: pico-repo-map-localization-v4-frozen

rows.final_answer: Fixed shipping rate selection in service_hub/shipping/policy.py so an existing requested region is used before default fallback, and missing method/absent default now raise KeyError naturally. Added checkout tests for region preference, missing method, and missing region without default. Verified with `pytest -q` (8 passed).

Fixed webhook dedup to key on (tenant_id, event_id), and only mark deliveries as seen after the handler succeeds. This preserves retries after handler failures and naturally raises KeyError for missing tenant_id/event_id before handler/store changes. Added webhook tests for tenant scoping, retry-after-failure, and missing-key behavior. Verified with: pytest -q tests/test_webhooks.py tests/test_notifications.py tests/test_auth.py tests/test_catalog.py tests/test_checkout.py (9 passed).

Implemented transitive role permission resolution in `service_hub/auth/policy.py` with deduplication, unknown-role `KeyError`, and cycle detection via `ValueError("role inheritance cycle")`, while preserving public APIs and leaving inputs unchanged. Added auth tests covering inheritance, deduplication, unknown direct/inherited roles, and cycles. Verified with `pytest -q` — 10 passed.

Updated catalog rename flow to treat same-slug renames as no-ops and invalidate exactly product:{item_id} plus both old/new slug cache keys on successful renames, preserving unrelated entries and tolerating missing keys. Added tests for exact invalidation, no-op behavior, unknown item KeyError, duplicate slug ValueError, and harmless missing cache keys. Verification via test execution is still pending because run_shell was not invoked in this pass.

Updated notification locale fallback in service_hub/notifications/locale.py to use exact locale, then base language for hyphenated locales, then default, and raise KeyError when no candidate exists. Added tests for base-language fallback, default fallback, and missing-template KeyError. Verified with pytest -q: 8 passed.

Updated service_hub/shipping/policy.py so region-specific rates are used when present; fallback now occurs only when the region is absent, and missing selected methods/default region naturally raise KeyError. Verified with pytest -q: 5 passed.

Fixed public webhook dedup flow: dedupe key is now (tenant_id, event_id), missing keys raise KeyError before side effects, and deliveries are only recorded after handler success so failures remain retryable. Added/updated webhook tests covering duplicate handling, cross-tenant reuse, retry after failure, and missing-key behavior. Verified with `pytest -q tests/test_webhooks.py` (5 passed).

Implemented transitive role permission resolution in `service_hub/auth/policy.py` with deduplication, unknown-role `KeyError`, and cycle detection via `ValueError("role inheritance cycle")`, while preserving public APIs and input immutability. Expanded `tests/test_auth.py` to cover direct, transitive, multi-role dedup, unknown direct/inherited roles, and inheritance cycles. Verified with `pytest -q` -> 10 passed.

Fixed rename_catalog_item flow by updating service_hub/catalog/service.py so successful renames invalidate product:id plus both old/new slug views, while same-slug renames are true no-ops. Added catalog tests covering exact cache invalidation, no-op rename, KeyError/ValueError rollback behavior, and harmless missing cache keys. Verified with pytest -q: 10 passed.

Updated service_hub/notifications/locale.py to resolve templates in this order: exact locale, base language for hyphenated locales, then default, otherwise raise KeyError(locale). Added notification tests covering exact match, base-language fallback, default fallback, and missing-template error. Verified with pytest -q: 8 passed.

Updated service_hub/shipping/policy.py so region-specific rates are used when present, with fallback only to rate_table["default"] when the region is absent. This preserves KeyError behavior for a missing method in the selected table and for a missing region when no default exists. Verified with pytest -q: 5 passed.

Updated the public webhook flow to dedupe by (tenant_id, event_id) and to record deliveries only after the handler succeeds. This preserves retryability on handler failure and naturally raises KeyError before handler/store changes when tenant_id or event_id is missing. Added coverage for cross-tenant reuse, retry-after-failure, and missing-key behavior. Verified with: `pytest -q tests/test_webhooks.py tests/test_notifications.py tests/test_auth.py tests/test_catalog.py tests/test_checkout.py` (8 passed).

Implemented transitive role permission resolution in service_hub/auth/policy.py with deduplication, unknown-role KeyError behavior, and cycle detection via ValueError("role inheritance cycle"). Added auth tests covering direct permissions, transitive inheritance, deduplication, unknown direct/inherited roles, and cycles. Verified with `pytest -q` (10 passed).

Fixed rename_catalog_item flow: successful rename now invalidates exactly product:{item_id}, slug:{old_slug}, and slug:{new_slug}; renaming to the same slug is a no-op; failure cases leave catalog/cache unchanged; missing cache keys remain harmless. Updated catalog tests to cover success, no-op, conflict, unknown item, exact cache preservation, and harmless missing keys. Verified with `pytest -q` -> 10 passed.

Implemented locale fallback for receipt rendering in `service_hub/notifications/locale.py`: exact locale, then base language for hyphenated locales, then `default`, naturally raising `KeyError` if no candidate exists. Added notification tests covering exact match, base-language fallback, default fallback, and missing-template error. Verified with `pytest -q` -> 8 passed.

Fixed checkout shipping rate resolution in service_hub/shipping/policy.py so region-specific tables take precedence, default is used only when the region is absent, and missing method/required default still raise KeyError naturally. Verified with pytest -q: 5 passed.

Fixed webhook deduplication in the public flow: dedupe key now includes both tenant_id and event_id, and deliveries are only marked seen after the handler succeeds so failed attempts remain retryable. This also preserves KeyError behavior for missing tenant_id/event_id before handler/store changes. Added coverage for cross-tenant reuse, retry-after-failure, and missing-key cases. Verified with `pytest -q` (8 passed).

Implemented transitive role permission resolution in service_hub/auth/policy.py with deduplication, unknown-role KeyError handling, and ValueError("role inheritance cycle") detection, while preserving public APIs and input immutability. Verified with pytest -q: 5 passed.

Updated catalog rename flow to no-op on same slug and invalidate exactly product:{id}, slug:{old}, and slug:{new} on successful rename. Preserved KeyError/ValueError behavior with no cache/catalog mutation on failures. Added coverage for exact invalidation, no-op rename, failure atomicity, and missing cache keys. Verified with `pytest -q` (10 passed).

Updated locale fallback in `service_hub/notifications/locale.py` to resolve templates in order: exact locale, base language for hyphenated locales, then `default`, otherwise raise `KeyError(locale)`. Added notification tests covering base-language fallback, default fallback, and missing-template error. Verified with `pytest -q` passing: 8 passed.

Fixed checkout shipping selection in service_hub/shipping/policy.py so an existing requested region is used first, with fallback only to rate_table["default"]. This preserves KeyError for a missing method in the selected table and for a missing region when no default exists. Verified with pytest -q: 5 passed.

Fixed webhook deduplication in the public flow: keys now require both tenant_id and event_id, missing keys raise KeyError before handler/store changes, and deliveries are marked seen only after successful handler completion so failed attempts remain retryable. Added tests for cross-tenant reuse, retry-after-failure, and missing key behavior. Verified with `pytest -q` -> 9 passed.

Implemented transitive role permission resolution in `service_hub/auth/policy.py` with deduplication, unknown-role `KeyError`, and cycle detection via `ValueError("role inheritance cycle")`, while preserving public APIs and leaving inputs unchanged. Added auth tests covering transitive inheritance, deduplication, unknown direct/inherited roles, and cycles. Verified with `pytest -q` -> 10 passed.
Partially updated tests and cache invalidation helper, but the flow is not fully fixed or verified yet because the rename service/store logic still needs changes and tests were not run.

rows.final_answer: Updated service_hub/notifications/locale.py so template lookup is exact locale, then base language for hyphenated locales, then default, with KeyError preserved when default is absent. Added notification tests for base-language fallback, default fallback, and missing-candidate failure. Verified with pytest: 8 passed.

Fixed the checkout shipping selection in `service_hub/shipping/policy.py` so an existing region table is always used first, and fallback to `default` happens only when the region is absent. This preserves KeyError behavior for missing methods in the selected table and for missing regions when no default exists. Verified with `pytest -q`: 5 passed.

Updated webhook deduplication to key by (tenant_id, event_id) and only mark deliveries seen after handler success, preserving retries on failures and KeyError behavior for missing IDs before side effects. Added focused webhook tests for cross-tenant reuse, retry-after-failure, and missing-field cases. Verified with `pytest -q` (9 passed).

Implemented transitive role permission resolution in `service_hub/auth/policy.py` behind the existing public authorize flow. It now deduplicates permissions, supports inheritance across all roles, raises `KeyError` for unknown roles via direct lookup, and raises `ValueError("role inheritance cycle")` on cycles without mutating inputs. Verified with `pytest -q`: 5 passed.

Updated the public catalog rename flow to invalidate exactly product:{item_id} plus slug:{old_slug} and slug:{new_slug} on successful slug changes, while making same-slug renames a full no-op. Preserved failure behavior so unknown items raise KeyError and conflicting slugs raise ValueError without mutating catalog or cache. Added focused tests for cache invalidation, no-op rename, and failure atomicity. Verified with `pytest -q` (9 passed).

Updated service_hub/notifications/locale.py to resolve templates in order: exact locale, base language for hyphenated locales, then default, raising KeyError(locale) if none exist. Added notification tests for base-language fallback, default fallback, and missing-template KeyError. Verified with `pytest -q` (8 passed).
